Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ProfessionalPidSymbolLibrary

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ProfessionalPidSymbolLibrary
public final class ProfessionalPidSymbolLibrary extends Object
Authored vector symbol families for the ISO 10628 professional drawing workflow.

Equipment, valve function, actuator and instrument location are separate semantics. The catalogue records its standards basis without assigning a fabricated ISO registration number or claiming an independent standards review. Unknown equipment fails closed instead of silently becoming a generic box. No licensed standard artwork is embedded.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
